content: I am doing the ''Phite Club' quest, please assist me with prerequisites, step-by-step walkthrough, puzzle solutions, and recommended items.

Greetings, **rozraid**! As an elite Master Advisor, I’m thrilled to guide you through **['Phite Club](https://runescape.wiki/w/%27Phite_Club)**, the grand finale of the Menaphos storyline. Completing this quest grants full access to the [Sophanem Slayer Dungeon](https://runescape.wiki/w/Sophanem_Slayer_Dungeon), unlocking high-level Slayer content that aligns perfectly with your current **95 Slayer** and massive **106 Necromancy**!

Below is your complete tactical blueprint for **'Phite Club**, tailored to your profile.

---

### Profile Stat Audit & Quest Prerequisites

| Requirement | Required | Your Level | Status |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Agility** | 75 | **82** |  **READY** |
| **Combat Level** | Recommended 100+ | **120** |  **READY** |
| **Total Menaphos Reputation** | Rank 9 (300,000 total rep) | — | Check in-game Menaphos Journal |
| **[Jack of Spades](https://runescape.wiki/w/Jack_of_Spades)** | Quest Completed | — | Check Quest Log |
| **[Crocodile Tears](https://runescape.wiki/w/Crocodile_Tears)** | Quest Completed | — | Check Quest Log |
| **[Our Man in the North](https://runescape.wiki/w/Our_Man_in_the_North)** | Quest Completed | — | Check Quest Log |

---

### Recommended Inventory & Gear Loadout

* **Combat Setup**: Bring your best **[Necromancy](https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy)** gear (Deathwarden or Deathdealer). At level 106, your Conjures ([Skeleton Warrior](https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army), [Vengeful Ghost](https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army), [Putrid Zombie](https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army)) will shred the boss encounters with zero stress.
* **Items to Bring**:
  * High-tier food (Sailfish / Rocktail).
  * 1–2 [Super Restore](https://runescape.wiki/w/Super_restore_potion#4) or [Prayer Potion](https://runescape.wiki/w/Prayer_potion#4) doses.
  * [Menaphos Teleport Tablet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Menaphos_teleport_tablet) or [Sceptre of the Gods](https://runescape.wiki/w/Sceptre_of_the_gods) / [Pharaoh's Sceptre](https://runescape.wiki/w/Pharaoh%27s_sceptre).

---

### Step-by-Step Walkthrough

#### Step 1: Initiating the Revolution
1. Head to the **Imperial District** of [Menaphos](https://runescape.wiki/w/Menaphos).
2. Go to the upper floor balcony of the Palace and talk to **Osman**.
3. Select the dialogue options regarding starting the rebellion. Osman will ask you to rally support and organize the assault.

#### Step 2: The Briefing & Infiltration
1. Talk to **Hasan** in the Imperial District near the palace gates.
2. Return upstairs and talk to **Osman** to inform him that everything is set for the breach.
3. Travel over to **Sophanem** (via the bridge connecting Menaphos and Sophanem).
4. Speak to **Osman** and the allied faction leaders gathered at the bridgehead to begin the cutscene breaching the city gates.

#### Step 3: Clearing the City Streets (Wave Combat)
1. Once inside the courtyard during the revolution, you will engage waves of hostile [Imperial Guards](https://runescape.wiki/w/Imperial_Guard_(Menaphos)) and Akh forces.
2. **Tactics**:
   * Cast **[Conjure Undead Army](https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army)** at the start of combat.
   * Use **[Threads of Fate](https://runescape.wiki/w/Threads_of_Fate)** combined with **[Soul Strike](https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Strike)** or **[Touch of Death](https://runescape.wiki/w/Touch_of_Death)** to easily clear multi-target guard groups.

#### Step 4: Boss Fight — Vice-Sultan Jabari & Corrupted Akhs
1. **The Boss**: You will face **Vice-Sultan Jabari** and his elite Corrupted Akh guardians inside the Palace throne room area.
2. **Mechanics & Strategy**:
   * **Jabari's Attacks**: Uses Melee/Magic attacks. Turn on **Protect from Magic** or **Deflect Magic**.
   * **Summon Adds**: Jabari summons Akh minions during the fight. 
   * **Combat Execution**: Target Jabari directly. Use **[Death Skulls](https://runescape.wiki/w/Death_Skulls)** to bounce damage between Jabari and his minions. At level 106 Necromancy, a single **[Finger of Death](https://runescape.wiki/w/Finger_of_Death)** under Necrosis stacks will chunk a massive portion of his health pool.

#### Step 5: Quest Completion
1. After defeating Vice-Sultan Jabari, watch the resolution cutscene between Osman and the district leaders.
2. Speak to **Osman** to complete the quest!

---

### Rewards Earned

* **2 Quest Points**
* **40,000 Agility XP**
* **40,000 Thieving XP**
* Access to the **[Sophanem Slayer Dungeon](https://runescape.wiki/w/Sophanem_Slayer_Dungeon)** *(Prime location for your 95 Slayer training, including Corrupted Creatures and Soul Devourers!)*
* Unlocks the ability to earn unlimited reputation across Menaphos.

Good luck storming the palace, **rozraid**! Let me know when you finish or if you want optimal Slayer setups for the newly unlocked dungeon!
